High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready errata card for [[Besieged (Errata)]] (the card with its Decipher errata text and the errata mark) (A New Hope, Dark Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Errata/Dark_E/Besieged _ E.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1065Tu3NsoBhFVuu9KuRFdtuIH30XaZeC/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Besieged _ E.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,340,268 bytes, SHA-256 <code>dfb9ac69b62385c29c1cadf2d836d416877a2b70f8754c7790e01b7f59f11b27</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 46.0, 47.5, 74.0, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.

This credited print-ready fan rendition is an explicit later full-card comparison for [[Besieged (Errata)]], not a scan of its historical document source. The actual 1998 published entry is [[:File:ANH-D-Besieged-Decipher-Glossary-1998-p25-entry.png]]. Its automatic High-Res Scan association on that document article has been removed; this file, original TIFF provenance and credit are preserved.

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project.
